notes: Jacketed CSTR, propylene oxide hydrolysis, first order: k = 16.96e12 exp(-E/RT) 1/h with E = 75.36 MJ/kmol EXACTLY (75.4 moves the unstable state 63.1 -> 63.45 C), dH = -251.2 MJ/kmol (Fogler x3 variant), CA0 = 2.114 kmol/m3, rho cp = 3.57 MJ/(m3 K), R = 8.314e-3 MJ/(kmol K). Steady states G(T) = R(T) with G = -dH CA0 Q X, X = (V/Q)k/(1+(V/Q)k), R = Q rho cp (T - T0) + UA (T - Tc). ignition_coolant_only: lowest Tc (feed stays 25 C) with a low branch (47.4 C). ignition_feed_and_coolant: lowest T0 = Tc (33.1 C). UA drop: from the hot state at t = 0.1 h UA falls to 30 % (-70 %), LSODA dynamics (CA, T), time for T to rise 5/10/20 K above the hot state; the new hot steady state is ~152 C. Stability test: d(G-R)/dT < 0.
